verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only fixed, built-in automatic behaviors: the data room collects documents behind the scenes, the cap table auto-links, and the Gusto sync can grant equity from offer-letter promises. None of these is a user-configurable automation that runs autonomously in the background; they are adjacent platform features. Probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec, so nothing indicates a user-defined automation or agent capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
